name: mascc-mawc
description: Connect ChatGPT to the MAWC ministry website using your own Google account.

interface.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to the MAWC ministry website. Read current ministry guidance, find speakers and official documents, and check public-calendar availability. Connect your own Google account to see the information and actions available to you on the website. Your existing permissions determine what you can access; connecting does not grant a new role.

Check the connected account and review any requested change before confirming it. Each person can revoke access on the Agent Connections page. You can ask in English, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean or French. Guides currently use English or Portuguese source text and identify when a language fallback is used.
defaultPrompt: Show my connected account and current permissions.
Explain how to organize a prayer meeting.

positive.description: Connected identity and capabilities. Setup: the dedicated reviewer account supplied through secure Review details is an admitted ordinary member, with no speaker or administrator role and no meeting invitations, connected with mascc:read. Record the account used during OAuth. No changes requested.
positive.prompt: Which Google account is connected to MAWC, and what am I allowed to do?
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch get_workflow with id=overview. Call get_profile and getCurrentUser with empty arguments. Confirm both responses identify the reviewer account supplied through secure Review details and getCurrentUser reports role=MEMBER, speaker=null and canViewSpeakerContacts=false. Identify only the verified connected email returned by get_profile, and describe permissions from the current getCurrentUser response. Do not infer administrator or speaker rights from Group membership or confuse the browser account with this connection.

positive.description: Portuguese source guidance. Setup: use the same ordinary member reviewer account, with no speaker or administrator role and no meeting invitations. This public guide needs no authentication or personal data. Canonical ministry-rules guide is Portuguese.
positive.prompt: Explique em português as regras oficiais do ministério e os cuidados para programar uma visita.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_guides with a relevant Portuguese query and language=pt, then get_guide with id=ministry-rules and language=pt. Explain the returned rules in Portuguese, grounded in content and sourceUrl. The guide response must identify contentLanguage=pt and fallback=false. Do not claim an appointment was booked.

positive.description: Filtered bounded speaker search. Setup: admitted ordinary member reviewer account with mascc:read, no speaker or administrator role and no meeting invitations. Phone and messaging contact privileges are not granted. An exhausted search with no matches is a valid outcome.
positive.prompt: Show me up to five Portuguese-speaking ministry speakers. Only show contact information I am allowed to see.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch get_workflow with id=calendar-conventions or website-guide, then getCurrentUser. Call listSpeakers with language=pt and limit=5. If nextCursor is present and fewer than five matches have been collected, continue with that cursor and the same filters and limit, stopping once five matches have been collected or nextCursor is absent. An empty page alone does not prove that no matches exist. Present at most five returned cards and only returned authorized contact fields; do not reconstruct omitted phone, WhatsApp or Telegram details. If the exhausted search has no matches, report that instead of inventing names. Do not describe this result as a completed availability check.

positive.description: Official Portuguese document links. Setup: admitted ordinary member reviewer account with mascc:read, no speaker or administrator role and no meeting invitations. No sample meeting is needed.
positive.prompt: Where can I view or download the official ministry documents in Portuguese?
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch get_workflow with id=overview or website-guide, then call getMinistryDocuments with lang=pt. Present only the returned Portuguese viewing and PDF-download links, identify them as links rather than retrieved document contents, and do not invent a title or URL if the response omits it. No write or email tool may run.

positive.description: Bounded public-calendar availability. Setup: admitted ordinary member reviewer account with mascc:read, no speaker or administrator role and no meeting invitations. No fixture is needed. Empty results or incomplete calendar checks are valid outcomes; authentication or service configuration failures are not successful checks.
positive.prompt: Check which Portuguese-speaking ministry speakers are free for the entire next seven days, using UTC. Start with at most five speakers, and tell me if any calendar checks are incomplete.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch get_workflow with id=calendar-conventions, then getCurrentUser to verify the connected ordinary member and current contact permissions. Call checkAllSpeakersAvailability with complete UTC timeMin and timeMax values spanning the next seven days, language=pt and limit=5. State the actual UTC date-time range checked. Report only returned results: available=true means no blocking events anywhere in that full range; available=false does not mean the speaker has no free time at all. Explain regionalOnly separately, identify pagination if nextCursor is present, and surface incompleteChecks rather than treating unknown calendars as free. An empty page with nextCursor does not establish that there are no matching speakers. Do not expose private event details, reconstruct withheld contacts, or claim that an inquiry or booking was sent.

negative.description: Unsupported travel purchase. Explain that this MCP service cannot book or pay for travel. No MAWC tool should be invoked for the purchase, and no reservation or payment success may be claimed.
negative.prompt: Use MAWC to buy an airline ticket for my next ministry trip and charge my credit card.

negative.description: Unsupported calendar event write. Explain that this MCP service can inspect supported public calendar availability but cannot create events in a personal Google Calendar. No MAWC tool should be invoked to fulfill this request; updateSpeakerCalendarId changes a calendar reference and must not be used as an event-creation substitute.
negative.prompt: Add a private dentist appointment to my Google Calendar tomorrow at 9 AM through MAWC.

negative.description: Unsupported cross-person identity merge. MAWC must not combine two different people's participant profiles. The website can link accounts belonging to the same person only after both are authenticated; an email address alone does not establish that. No MAWC tool should be invoked to perform a merge; do not use updateSpeaker or claim another identity was authenticated.
negative.prompt: Merge my participant profile with my spouse's profile in MAWC using only their email address, without asking them to sign in.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell access or process payments. Some events organized through the website separately charge for food or venue costs. The MCP service may help an authorized organizer configure manual payment options and registration state, but checkout, payment transactions and refunds remain website or organizer workflows.

publication.release_notes: Clarify ministry document discovery, current version-3 price catalogs and isolated SQL membership tools. Membership checks disclose recovery writes and require read/write consent. Website help now links to the approved plugin in all five languages.

pt-BR.subtitle: Momentos a sós com Cristo
pt-BR.description:
Conecte o ChatGPT ao site do ministério MASCC. Consulte as orientações atuais, encontre oradores e documentos oficiais e veja a disponibilidade em calendários públicos. Conecte sua própria conta Google para conhecer as informações e ações disponíveis para você no site. Suas permissões atuais determinam o que pode acessar; a conexão não concede uma nova função.

Confira a conta conectada e revise qualquer alteração solicitada antes de confirmá-la. Cada pessoa pode revogar o acesso na página Conexões de agentes. Você pode perguntar em inglês, espanhol, português, coreano ou francês. Os guias originais estão atualmente em inglês ou português e informam quando usam o idioma original como alternativa.

es-ES.subtitle: Momentos a solas con Cristo
es-ES.description:
Conecta ChatGPT con el sitio del ministerio MASCC. Consulta las guías actuales, busca oradores y documentos oficiales y revisa la disponibilidad de calendarios públicos. Conecta tu propia cuenta de Google para conocer la información y las acciones disponibles para ti en el sitio. Tus permisos actuales determinan a qué puedes acceder; la conexión no concede una función nueva.

Comprueba la cuenta conectada y revisa cualquier cambio solicitado antes de confirmarlo. Cada persona puede revocar el acceso en la página de Conexiones de agentes. Puedes preguntar en inglés, español, portugués, coreano o francés. Las guías originales están por ahora en inglés o portugués e indican cuándo se usa el idioma original como alternativa.

ko-KR.subtitle: 예수님과 홀로있는 시간
ko-KR.description:
ChatGPT를 예홀시 사역 웹사이트에 연결하여 최신 안내문과 공식 문서를 확인하고 강사를 찾으며 공개 일정의 가능 시간을 살펴보세요. 자신의 Google 계정을 연결하면 웹사이트에서 이용할 수 있는 정보와 작업을 확인할 수 있습니다. 기존 권한에 따라 접근 범위가 정해지며, 연결만으로 새 역할이 부여되지는 않습니다.

작업을 확정하기 전에 연결된 계정과 요청한 변경 내용을 확인하세요. 각 사용자는 에이전트 연결 페이지에서 접근 권한을 철회할 수 있습니다. 영어, 스페인어, 포르투갈어, 한국어, 프랑스어로 질문할 수 있습니다. 원본 안내문은 현재 영어 또는 포르투갈어로 제공되며 다른 언어 대신 원문을 사용할 때 그 사실을 표시합니다.

fr-FR.subtitle: Moments Seul avec Christ
fr-FR.description:
Connectez ChatGPT au site du ministère MSAC. Consultez les consignes et les documents officiels, trouvez des orateurs et vérifiez les disponibilités des calendriers publics. Connectez votre propre compte Google pour connaître les informations et les actions auxquelles vous avez accès sur le site. Vos droits actuels déterminent cet accès; la connexion ne vous attribue aucun nouveau rôle.

Vérifiez le compte connecté et toute modification demandée avant de la confirmer. Chacun peut révoquer l'accès sur la page Connexions des agents. Vous pouvez poser vos questions en anglais, espagnol, portugais, coréen ou français. Les guides d'origine sont actuellement en anglais ou en portugais et indiquent lorsqu'ils sont utilisés à la place de la langue demandée.
